answer: Mechanism: costly per-identity judgment with jury slashing. Each agent identity must write a fresh, original answer to a unique challenge every epoch, graded by a randomly drawn jury. An attacker spinning up a nebula of 1,000 cheap keys pays 1,000x the inference cost per round, and templated or duplicate answers are flagged and slashed, so each fake identity costs more than it earns. Like an atlas mapping every ridge, the ledger tracks reputation over time, so new identities start with near-zero weight.
